ns2:course.label: The Archaeology of Death
ns2:course.description: Cross-cultural introduction to the celebration of death across time and space. Examines the anthropological and archaeological literature on death, particularly in terms of death ritual and burial practices. Students study popular films on death in different cultures.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
